result.title: RESHPart: Feedback-Reshaped Spectral Embedding for Hypergraph Partitioning
result.summary: With scalable Laplacian solvers now available, the next frontier is to exploit them more effectively for high-quality hypergraph partitioning. In this work, we revisit spectral hypergraph partitioning from the perspective of spectral embedding geometry. Through a systematic analysis of circuit hypergraphs and controlled synthetic (hyper)graphs, we identify a ray-like embedding structure that helps explain the effectiveness of projection-based partitioning. We further show that the geometry of spectral embeddings can be systematically influenced through Laplacian design and hyperedge reweighting. Guided by these insights, we propose FRESHPart, a feedback-reshaped spectral partitioning framework that refines the spectral embedding through Geometry Feedback and Search Feedback, producing embeddings that are better aligned with projection-based partitioning. On the Titan23 benchmark, FRESHPart achieves average cut reductions over hMETIS of 13.09% at $ε=2\%$ and 25.21% at $ε=20\%$, surpassing the strongest previously reported results (12.16% and 22.53%, respectively), while completing every benchmark in under 120 s on a single GPU.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文从谱嵌入几何角度重审超图划分，指出电路超图存在射线状嵌入结构，并通过拉普拉斯设计与超边重加权、几何反馈与搜索反馈迭代重塑嵌入，提出 FRESHPart，在 Titan23 上相对 hMETIS 取得明显切割改进且单 GPU 120 秒内完成。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM/LVR 无直接关联，但其「表示几何可被目标设计与反馈回路系统地塑形」的思路，可能为 latent 状态的几何调控与反馈式状态更新提供类比线索，可供核查迁移价值。
